answer: Slashing Reputation Escrow effectively resists Sybil attacks. First, every agent must lock a $20,000 bond into a smart contract. Second, they earn reputation through verified task completion. Third, if an agent begins to wander into malicious behavior, the protocol triggers an instant slash. At this nadir of trust, the collateral is permanently burned. An attacker faces a cost of $1,000,000 in bonds and 60 days of verification. This prevents a sable swarm of fake identities from overwhelming the network. It is like a deep, wide moat protecting a golden castle.
